method: Skill aggregate rg scan plus full manual structure and declaration review; not a native renderer test

rules.reason: Single component scope; task confirms host defaultDisplayBlock/defaultContentBox. No app configuration edited.
Component declaration only; no page in input scope.
No Worklet.
No include/template fragments.
Reviewed complete attributes; no backslash quote escapes.
Only view/text/scroll-view native elements.
No match-media or keyboard-accessory.
No listed WebView-only attributes.
No images/SVG.
Single scroll-view explicitly type=custom.
Custom horizontal layout; no list virtualization.
No nested scroll-view.
scroll-x and enable-flex true; explicit flex-direction:row.
Direct child fit-content has width:100%; viewport 320px; item flex-basis 0 gives equal halves.
No refresher.
No navigator.
All text elements contain only literal text or interpolation.
No inline media or mixed-content paragraph.
No sticky behavior.
No picker-view.
No swiper.
Every media selector is card-webview, assigned only outside Skyline. Skyline small class uses windowWidth<=320.
Attribute selector replaced by badge-sale class; only class selectors remain.
Title retains WebView CSS and adds max-lines=1/overflow=ellipsis; interpolation has no literal whitespace.
Two labels have width:50%; scroll items have definite allocated width; remaining flex wrappers contain block views.
Only single-value hidden retained for title and outer.
Grid replaced by explicit row Flex; no other listed unsupported layout properties.
No listed unsupported values.
City-Semibold has independent @font-face family. Trip-Medium is host-provided; preserve approved family without unapproved bold substitution. Binary PostScript metadata is unavailable.
Keep approved 600/500 weights; target device weight matching remains unverified.
No text decoration.
No border/radius combinations.
Only solid backgrounds; no multi-layer background/mask.
Independent blur retained; compound blur->brightness split into inner blur and outer brightness.
RGBA internal commas are not shadow separators; two opaque shadows split into same-size nested boxes in original paint order.
No calc().
No pseudo-elements/animations.
No animation.
No transition/animation.
No z-index/fixed/transform/opacity dependencies. Filter composition uses direct nesting without layer comparison.

Host and tips-wrapper explicitly column Flex. Positive 28rpx wrapper margin compensates original collapsed -28rpx to retain content top 92rpx. Ordinary -8rpx margin untouched. Algebra checked; actual renderer geometry not_run.
No ids or selector queries.
No animation API.
No node()/ScrollViewContext acquisition, so enhanced is not required.
No SelectorQuery.
Only title property; correct value field.
No wx:for.
title is String with a string default; no caller in input, interface preserved.
